Name: Kimchi Maker Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[b][left]﻿[/left]Languages Available: [/b]English (US) 
[b]Documentation[/b]: Informational spreadsheet coming soon 

[center][b]﻿[/b][/center][size=5]About[/size]
[size=2]Kimchi Maker Continued is a 1.6 compatible version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5233?tab=description]Kimchi Maker[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43625872]deffiliation[/url], rewritten to work with Stardew 1.6, Content Patcher, and the Cornucopia family of mods. This was necessary because JSON Assets and PPJA have been deprecated. [/size]

[b]Changes from Original[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]Crock renamed to Onggi [/size]
[*][size=2]removed mail notifying that the onggi is for sale (will be added in a future update) [/size]
[*][size=2]Added an optional expansion that adds several additional types of kimchi with their own specific recipes in addition to the default kimchi[/size]
[/list][b][size=5]Obtaining Recipes [/size][/b][left]
The onggi blueprints are mailed to you by your mother in the fall or winter of year 2. The recipes for Kimchi Tuna Stew and Kimchi Fried Rice can be purchased from Gus starting in Year 2. [/left]

Downloads.Description:
Delete prior versions of this mod. Place all folders and subfolders into your mod folder

Restores mail from original mod, fixes issue where Cornucopia is required for base mod. The crafting recipe for Onggi is now mailed to you, not bought from Robin
